feeds.title: HBCU Buzz
feeds.description: HBCU news, insights & editorials from the Black College community. Since 2011, HBCU Buzz has been a resource for prospective & current students and alumni, and the most influential brand in the HBCU Community.

feeds.title: HBCU Gameday
feeds.description: On the field. Behind the basket. In the pressbox. Bringing you HBCU Sports like you've never seen it before. HBCU Gameday was formed in 2012 by Steven J. Gaither in an effort to create an outlet that offered authentic and in-depth coverage of HBCU Sports and Culture.

feeds.title: HBCU News
feeds.description: HBCU News covers Historically Black Colleges & Universities, Politics, Campus News, HBCU Research, Sports and stories related to the African American Community. We are storytellers and journalists united by a mission to inform and empower the HBCU and African American community.

feeds.title: HBCU Sports
feeds.description: What began as a sports information website dedicated to covering the SWAC (Southwestern Athletic Conference), HBCU Sports has evolved to become a leader in covering the entire HBCU sports landscape. Created in 1997 as The SWAC Page, today HBCU Sports is one of the largest and most visited HBCU sports information sites on the Web.

feeds.title: HBCU Community Development Blog
feeds.description: HBCUCDC believes that the obstacles that once prevented the continued development of the communities surrounding HBCUs no longer exist. And now is experienced in all stages of the community development process. They have all knowledge required to serve their communities. Read about Historically Black Colleges and Universities Community Development in our blogs. They are a provider of Community Development Solutions for HBCUs and their surrounding communities

feeds.title: The HBCU Career Center Blog
feeds.description: The HBCU Career Center is a leading source for diversity jobs, career news and job search tips. Read the blog at TheHBCUCareerCenter.com. The HBCU Career Center is on a mission to support the career development of HBCU students and alumni by bridging the gap between educational and corporate life, all while helping organizations diversify teams and hire amazing Black talent.

feeds.title: HBCU Lifestyle Blog
feeds.description: We're committed to keeping you connected to the black college living experience, bringing you the latest on everything, from scholarships and dorm living to Greek life and alumni giving. HBCU Lifestyle is led by Richard and Garrick Gibson, a father and son team with a passion for Historically Black Colleges and Universities (HBCU).

feeds.title: The Showcase of HBCU Blog
feeds.description: Our blog provides you with our latest announcements. The Showcase of Historically Black Colleges and Universities (HBCUs) is a college & career fair marketed predominantly toward African American students and other students who desire to attend an HBCU.

feeds.title: HBCU Coalition
feeds.description: Find out about our news, events, programs, and blogs here. The HBCU Community Development Action Coalition (CDAC) was developed to help bring stakeholders together such as HBCU's, MSI's (minority-serving institutions), CDCs (Community Development Corporations), and the Community Economic Development Industry.
